verdict.rationale: YYLO is a coding-agent orchestrator, so a codebase-conventions context file is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence shows no documented project context file that agents read when planning or generating code. The closest items are adjacent: Ledger Wiki stores Markdown knowledge, with no evidence it is injected into agent context, and Skills are procedures for operating YYLO and Ledger, not descriptions of codebase conventions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a context file describing my codebase conventions so agents generate more relevant plans and code
